verdict.rationale: Formant has a dedicated docs guide, "Trigger webhooks from events," stating that a webhook can make an HTTP API call to any endpoint when a Formant event fires. That is the core of subscribing to events via webhooks. Alerting on anomalies is also documented as a source of such events. Missing for 10: detail on supported event types, payload format, delivery guarantees/retries and signing/authentication, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
